newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down as CEZ fails to recover.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down as CEZ fails to recover.

text.p: The Czech PX50 edged lower again on Friday as power utility CEZ took an early dive and gains to SPT Telecom were offset by some heavy losses in the broader market.
The PX50 fell 0.05 percent to 601.1 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares was down 0.36 percent to 1,276.9.

SPT Telecom built on early gains to close up 31 crowns to 3,800 but CEZ, the second most heavily capitalsed share on the PX50 after SPT, failed to recover substantially from a sharp decline at the fixing and closed down 30 crowns to 1,210.
Despite a 2.4 percent fall, dealers said CEZ was unlikely to decline further and said support was aspecially strong at aroiund 1,200.
"Before the fixing there was a big fall but it seems that CEZ has very good support at 1,200 crowns," said Lubomir Vystavel from ING Barings.

In the broader market there were heavy losses to computer systems company PVT, which dropped 140 crowns to 3,500, conference organiser BVV Brno, which lost 100 crowns to 3,400 and Elektrarny Opatovice which declined 245 crowns to 4,657.
